_metadata.note: PLACEHOLDER pack — G-XXXXXXXXXX is not a real GA4 property. Owner replaces the GA4 Measurement ID constant's value after import; see README.md.
_metadata.importInstructions: GTM Admin > Import Container > choose this file > Workspace: New/existing > Merge (Rename conflicting tags/triggers/variables if any) > Confirm.
_metadata.pendingEventsNote: cta_click is not yet pushed to dataLayer in this repo's JS — a separate slice is adding the sticky CTA that pushes it (channel in {phone, telegram, form}). This tag/trigger pair is wired ahead of that push so no second GTM import is needed.

variable.name: GA4 Measurement ID
variable.notes: Owner: paste the real GA4 Measurement ID here after creating the GA4 property. Every tag below references this variable, never a hardcoded ID.

variable.name: DLV - channel
variable.notes: Reads dataLayer.channel pushed alongside the cta_click event (values: phone, telegram, form).

variable.name: DLV - source_page
variable.notes: Reads dataLayer.source_page, pushed by window.animaTrackLead() in assets/analytics.js.

variable.name: DLV - lead_origin
variable.notes: Reads dataLayer.lead_origin ('human' or 'agent'), pushed by window.animaTrackLead() in assets/analytics.js.

variable.name: JS - AI Referral Source
variable.notes: Empty string when document.referrer is missing or does not match one of the six named AI surfaces (chatgpt.com, chat.openai.com, perplexity.ai, gemini.google.com, copilot.microsoft.com, claude.ai). Used both as the ai_referral trigger condition and as the ai_source event parameter.

trigger.name: CE - cta_click
trigger.notes: Pending: fires once the sticky-CTA slice pushes dataLayer.push({event: 'cta_click', channel: ...}).

trigger.name: PV - AI Referral
trigger.notes: Fires on page view only when document.referrer host matches one of the six named AI surfaces.

tag.name: GA4 Event - lead_accepted
tag.notes: Mark as a key event in GA4 Admin > Events after import (markAsConversion mirrors the intent but the GA4 UI toggle is the source of truth for conversion reporting).

tag.name: GA4 Event - cta_click
tag.notes: Pending: see trigger 'CE - cta_click'. Safe to import now, no-ops until the sticky-CTA slice lands.
